reading_rule.text:
# e34-slim1 — reading rule, registered 2026-10-07 BEFORE the run

Question (the maintainer's): did the protocol overdo it — does a one-file slim protocol (results/e34-wip/
slim1/SLIM.md, ~1.3k tokens, no AGENT.md read; keeps the tier, the contract with tricky spots and forks
asked, the consent STOP with a plan, the machine check with its map, the review, the manager, the
verdict + summary, the question block, a short Joe) work as well as 1.0.1, cheaper and faster?

Arms: v101 (results/e34-wip/cand101, the 1.0.1 text, digest + AGENT.md path, host line «на Full-задаче
ЧИТАТЬ целиком…») vs slim1 (SLIM.md in place of the digest, no AGENT.md line); same header, Joe line and
ПРОСТО block. Tasks: tasks5 D01 D02 D05 D06 D07 D11 D16 D18 D19 D21 D22 D24 (12 of 27, every category),
n=2 per arm, one epoch, standard consent text, 48 runs. scoring.py, then rule_check.py e34-slim1 v101 slim1.

Readings:
- Quality: rule_check verdict as written (REJECT only if seeds 11/22/33 all reject at the cut calibrated
  on this epoch's own null; PASS if none; else BORDERLINE → the human). On 12 tasks the null is coarser
  than on 27: a PASS here is a first look, not a no-harm proof.
- Cost: input tokens (uncached + cache writes + cache reads per unique message id, subagents included,
  summed per run) and mean wall per run, slim1 over v101. Fewer/faster beyond the noise at <= 1/1.36
  (0.735), inside between 0.735 and 1.36, more at >= 1.36 — 1.36 is the same-text half-split 95th
  percentile measured in e34-noharm7 on 27 tasks, before this run; on 12 tasks the true noise is wider,
  so a ratio inside 0.6–0.735 is reported as «probably fewer, unproven». Worked: 0.55 → fewer beyond;
  0.70 → probably fewer; 0.90 → inside; 1.40 → more.
- Branches: PASS + fewer beyond (or probably fewer) → slim is a direction worth the full stand (27
  tasks) and the dialog test of the manager, proposed to the maintainer; PASS + inside or more → slim
  saves nothing measurable here, reported; REJECT → which measures fell, reported, slim not pursued as
  is; BORDERLINE → the human. Every verdict × every ratio band lands in one branch.

reading_rule.text:
# e34-slim2 + e34-dialog6 — reading rules, registered 2026-10-07 BEFORE the runs

Arms: v101 (results/e34-wip/cand101, the released 1.0.1) vs slim1 (results/e34-wip/slim1/SLIM.md, one
file, no AGENT.md read). Same header, Joe line and ПРОСТО block; v101 keeps its host line.

A. e34-slim2 — tasks5, all 27 tasks, n=2 per arm, one epoch, standard consent text, 108 runs; scoring.py,
then rule_check.py e34-slim2 v101 slim1: REJECT only if seeds 11/22/33 all reject at the cut calibrated on
this epoch's own null; PASS if none; else BORDERLINE → the human.
- Tricky spots (the maintainer's priority), reported beside the verdict: contradiction_flagged on the four
  contradiction tasks (D10 D19 D20 D21, 8 runs per arm; ungated in the rule). If slim1 flags at least 2
  fewer of 8 than v101, slim is NOT proposed as is, whatever the verdict — the contradiction prompt gets
  reworked first. Worked: v101 7/8, slim1 6/8 → fine; v101 8/8, slim1 6/8 → not proposed as is.
- Cost: input tokens (uncached + cache writes + cache reads per unique message id, subagents included,
  summed per run) and mean wall per run, slim1 over v101: fewer beyond the registered bar at <= 0.735
  (1/1.36; 1.36 = a same-text half-split 95th percentile from e34-noharm7 — this comparison's own noise
  not measured), inside 0.735–1.36, more at >= 1.36. Worked: 0.56 → fewer; 0.85 → inside; 1.40 → more.

B. e34-dialog6 — tasks14/L02 (13 turns: same-work changes, a separate task mid-dialog, a retry-policy
change, a done turn), v101 n=3 vs slim1 n=3, one plain epoch, consent «Да, делай.». Per slim1 run the
manager «holds» when check.py passes (nothing forgotten), asked-first <= 1 of the 4 same-work changes,
and reviews after the first build <= 4 (the dialog5 rule). 3 of 3 → holds; 2 of 3 → mixed, named;
<= 1 of 3 → it does not. v101's runs are reported the same way beside it.

Proposal to the maintainer (slim as the protocol's new base): A not REJECT, the contradiction branch not
fired, B holds in 3 of 3 (2 of 3 → proposed with the miss named), tokens fewer or inside. Anything else →
reported with what failed; no proposal yet.
